title: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys - Trading Village of Redmont
description:
A peaceful tune from Ys III. Good for any athletic theme.

Based on the PC-8801 version developed by Nihon Falcom instead of the SNES port by Tonkin House.

(Note: Some may know this town's name as Sarina. That's from the English translation given in the Mega Drive and the TurboGrafx-CD version.)
